start.title: Where are your notes?
start.hint: Pick one. BrainLink connects it to the AI apps on this computer. Your notes stay here.
start.nested: That folder holds several vaults. Pick one so they stay separate.
start.noNotesSub: Create a new brain in Documents/My Brain
folderFallback.title: Type the folder's path
folderFallback.hint: We couldn't open the folder picker. In your file manager, right-click the folder and look for an option like "Copy path" (or similar), then paste it below.
syncOnb.title: Keep notes on your other devices?
syncOnb.hint: Optional, and off by default. BrainLink never uses an account or API for this — it only watches a folder your own desktop client (Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox) already keeps in sync. Private vaults and sessions never leave this computer either way.
syncOnb.pickSub: A Google Drive, iCloud or Dropbox folder already on this computer
ask.title: Ask your brain
ask.hint: A cited answer pulled straight from your notes — click a source to open it. Never a guess: if it is not in your notes, BrainLink says so.
ask.placeholder: e.g. What did we decide about pricing?
ask.empty: Try: “What did we decide about pricing?”, “What changed this week?”, or any question about your notes.
ask.notInBrainBody: BrainLink looked through {vault} and found nothing that answers this. Try rephrasing, or add a note about it.
ready.sayCloseSuffix: to save what you decided into your notes.
ready.restartQuit: Quit and reopen {apps} so it loads BrainLink.
ready.assignAccess: Choose a Twin profile and access for each AI app in the connection section.
ready.restartNoApps: No AI apps were found on this computer. Install Claude Desktop, Cursor or Codex, then reload this page.
brain.title: Your brain
brain.hint: Every dot is a note; lines are links. BrainLink links new notes to the ones they mention or are about, and keeps a Home note that links everything.
brain.phrasesTitle: Things to say in any AI
brain.phrase1: Brief me what changed and what's open
brain.phrase3: Make a meeting note from this transcript: …
brain.smartOn: Smart search: keyword + meaning, using {model} on this computer.
brain.smartOff: Smart search: keyword. For meaning-based search, install Ollama (ollama.com) and run "ollama pull nomic-embed-text"; BrainLink picks it up automatically.
brain.mapEmpty: No notes yet — once you add some, their links show up here.
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: One timeline across every AI you connect — Claude, Cursor, Codex and more. Any session can open and read any other (the same {call} call every connected AI uses). Private sessions (the default for imports) show 🔒 and are hidden unless you ask to see them; they never sync.
sessions.privateNotice: Your imported sessions are private, so connected AI apps can't see any of them yet.
sessions.privateNoticeBtn: Let connected AI apps see summaries
sessions.shareSummariesLabel: Let connected AI apps see summaries of my imported AI sessions
sessions.shareFullTextLabel: Also let connected AI apps read full message text (not just summaries)
sessions.empty: No sessions yet. They show up once an AI logs one with session_log, or once local Claude Code / Codex history is found.
sessions.pendingCloseoutHint: These sessions ended. Review their outcomes with your AI and ask it to close the loop. A reminder does not save a summary.
sessions.hooksHint: Enable reminders for all local sessions in each app. Only the session identifier and end time stay on this computer; transcript text is not collected. Existing app hooks are preserved.
sessions.hookTrust: In Codex, open /hooks and review and trust the BrainLink reminder. Configuration alone does not mean it is running.
sessions.hookRestart: Start a new Claude Code session to load this hook. Reminders appear here after a session ends.
sessions.fileHint: Choose where this session belongs. Review the private draft before saving; it does not turn the summary into verified knowledge.
sessions.destinationSuggestion: Suggested destination: {vault}. This matches your saved choice for this exact project.
sessions.noDestinationSuggestion: No saved destination for this project yet. Choose one to continue.
sessions.rememberDestination: Remember this destination for this exact project
sessions.rememberDestinationAndFolder: Remember this vault and folder for this exact project
sessions.destinationRemembered: Saved. BrainLink will suggest this vault and folder for this project next time.
sessions.folderSuggestion.saved: Suggested folder: {folder}. You saved this folder for this exact project.
sessions.folderSuggestion.related_note: Suggested folder: {folder}. The summary mentions an existing note there.
sessions.folderSuggestion.related_notes: Suggested folder: {folder}. Most matching notes are there.
sessions.noDestination: Add a writable vault before filing sessions.
sessions.previewFirst: Preview the draft again after changing its destination.
sessions.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this proposed summary? It will stay in your vault and be marked withdrawn.
sessions.proposalWithdrawn: Proposal withdrawn. The private note stays in your vault.
sessions.findFiledHint: Choose one vault. BrainLink searches it only when you press Search; private summaries stay private.
sessions.noFiledSummaries: No proposed session summaries were found in this vault.
sessions.filedListLimit: Showing up to 100 summaries. There may be more.

sessions.noAuthorizedTwin: No Twin agent is authorized to read sessions.
sessions.invalidTwinChoice: Choose a listed Twin profile number.
handoffs.title: AI handoffs
handoffs.hint: Whenever one connected AI hands something off to another, it shows up here — who sent it, who picked it up, and when.
handoffs.empty: No handoffs between your connected AI apps yet.
handoffs.conflictHint: Open the mailbox to compare both updates.
vault.hint: Choose the Obsidian or Markdown folder your AIs should share. Notes stay on this computer.
vault.privateLabel: Private — hidden from search, answers, graph, sessions and sync for connected AIs
vault.excludedLabel: Excluded folders (one per line; never read, searched, answered from, graphed or synced)
vault.excludedHint: Suggestions: {list} — add any that apply to this vault.
vault.noneYet: No vaults yet — choose a folder above.
vault.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from BrainLink? Your notes are not touched.
rolePack.hint: Say an activation phrase in any connected AI to load the agent; say its close phrase to save the session to your vault.
rolePack.none: Agents come from the rule pack when you add a vault.
rolePack.allowCaptures: Allow {name} to write captures (otherwise proposals only)
rolePack.savedToast: Saved {name}. Restart your AI apps to pick up new phrases.
connect.hint: BrainLink auto-detects the AI apps already on this computer. One click adds BrainLink to that app's MCP settings (with a backup of the old file) and runs a live test call so you see it work immediately, not after a restart.
skills.title: BrainLink skills
skills.description: Install BrainLink workflows so this AI can use them. BrainLink updates only its own unchanged files.
skills.confirmRemove: Remove only unchanged skill files installed by BrainLink? Files you edited will be kept.
skills.installedToast: Skills installed or updated: {count}; already current: {unchanged}.
connect.httpDetails: Grok, custom agents and other HTTP clients
connect.httpHint: Run {cmd} and give the client the URL and token below. It listens on this computer only.
connect.profileHint: Choose which Twin profile this AI belongs to, then allow access only to the vaults and actions it needs.
connect.noVault: This profile has no available non-private vaults.
connect.permissionSummary: This AI can use only the actions you check, within the checked vaults and this Twin profile. Private and other profiles stay blocked.
connect.semanticRequired: Turn on semantic memory in this Twin profile before connecting an AI app.
connect.notFoundHint: Not found on this computer — install it, then reload this page.
connect.manualHint: One click adds BrainLink to Antigravity's global MCP settings and backs up the previous file. Then reload MCP servers or restart Antigravity.
connect.deepseekHint: BrainLink uses a separate config and access token for each named Harness profile. If an old shared connection is shown, disconnect it first, then connect each profile to the right Twin.
connect.none: No AI clients recognised on this computer yet.
test.hint: Ask any connected AI: {phrase}. Calls appear below (tool names only, never note content).
test.placeholder: Search your vault to check the index
sync.title: Sync
sync.hint: Choose a folder your Google Drive, iCloud, or Dropbox desktop app already syncs. Run sync yourself or set an interval. Scheduled sync runs while BrainLink is open; enable Start at sign-in to keep it running after you sign in. Private vaults are never synced.
sync.status.target-inside-vault: sync folder cannot be inside the vault
github.title: GitHub shared knowledge · review before publishing
github.hint: Preview selected visible notes against an existing local GitHub clone. A local commit and GitHub push each require a separate confirmation.
github.noProfiles: GitHub sharing is locked until you create a Personal, Organisation, or Client Twin profile. This keeps each shared repository tied to one data owner.
github.accessWarning: GitHub access applies to the whole repository, not individual folders. Keep Personal, Organisation, and each Client in separate repositories. Agents with direct GitHub access can bypass BrainLink permissions.
github.autoHint: After you turn this on, BrainLink checks this Twin’s approved folders and syncs safe changes both ways. Scheduled sync needs the BrainLink background process to be running; closing this browser tab does not stop it. To start BrainLink after you sign in, turn on “Start BrainLink in the background when I sign in” in Backup settings. Conflicts stop the run; no note is silently overwritten. The first run may publish approved notes to GitHub.
github.autoEnabled: Automatically sync this Twin’s approved notes
github.autoConfirm: Turn on automatic two-way sync for {name} with {remote}? Approved notes may be published to GitHub on this schedule. Private notes are filtered; conflicts pause the run.
github.repositoryRequired: Enter the path to a local clone of a GitHub repository.
github.assignProfileRepository: Assign a separate GitHub repository to this profile before sharing.
github.noProfileVault: This profile has no available non-private vaults.
github.committed: Local commit {commit} created. Nothing was pushed.

{paths}

agents.title: Agents
agents.hint: Any AI can connect with its own key on this computer. Cloud connections require a separately configured remote service.
agents.needVault: Add a vault first (above), then come back to add agents.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Add one so any AI can connect with its own key.
agents.copyKeyHint: Copy this key now — BrainLink will not show it again. Keep it somewhere safe.
agents.remoteNote: BrainLink runs locally on this computer. Cloud agents cannot reach it yet.

notes3d.empty: No notes yet — once you add some, their links show up here.

share.title: Share with cloud agents
share.hint: Give a cloud AI (for example a bot that only reads files) a read-only copy of your notes through a folder it can already reach. BrainLink never opens a network connection itself.
share.needVault: Add a folder first (above), then come back to share it.

share.confirmClearReshare: This will remove everything previously shared in that folder and start sharing fresh. Continue?
ingestion.title: Automatic source scans
ingestion.hint: Add folders from any public vault. BrainLink checks every folder once a day at your chosen local time, or when you press Scan now. Scans only list new or changed files; they never write knowledge notes automatically.
ingestion.emptyTargets: No folders added yet. Add at least one folder to scan.
ingestion.targetRequired: Choose a vault and an existing folder first.
ingestion.maxTargets: You can add up to 20 folders.
ingestion.duplicateTarget: That folder is already on the scan list.
ingestion.never: No source scan has run yet.

brief.enabled: Run a brief each day in the background
brief.saved: Daily brief saved. It runs while BrainLink is open; enable launch at sign-in to run after you log in.
brief.disabled: Daily briefs turned off. You can still run one manually.

backup.confirmRecoveryKey: Paste the recovery key to confirm you saved it

backup.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup into the empty destination? Existing vaults will not be changed.

startup.title: Keep scheduled work running
startup.enabled: Start BrainLink quietly when I sign in
startup.hint: Scheduled scans, briefs, backups, and sync run while BrainLink is open. Turn this on to start it quietly after you sign in. Clicking the app icon still opens Setup. Supports Windows, macOS, and desktop Linux.
startup.enabledToast: BrainLink will start quietly when you sign in.
startup.disabledToast: Background startup is off. Scheduled backups run only while BrainLink is open.

rsi.title: Improve BrainLink
rsi.hint: Capture ideas, evidence and experiments. Saving a proposal never changes live behavior.

rsi.discovery.hint: When turned on, BrainLink checks the selected public research and project sources for your topics and files relevant papers or projects here as Discovered proposals. Discoveries are never tested, accepted or released without your review.
